covers: the deployed 6091 case: a debit repeating a standalone number printed in the description
a number that is also the voucher number is left alone
a forbidden reference is rejected and its value, direction and derived amount are cleared
a rejected balance reference leaves the direction alone
the wrong amount column is reported without clearing
both sides non-zero, a non-numeric side, direction mismatch and a mismatched derived amount
the row id falls back to its position, and a clean document says nothing
the bank side, including its difference from the GL side: a non-numeric side is swallowed
the keyword tables accept Thai and Chinese column names and trailing punctuation
a comma-separated value is matched only after stripping the value's commas (the deployed quirk)

checks.note: each batch compares the returned warnings and the resulting row state (which values were cleared, which references were dropped); the keyword tables, the column sets and every helper are compared value by value as well

intentional_differences: the deployed _AMOUNT_TOKEN_RE pattern is not carried over: nothing in the deployed project ever used it, so there is no rule to preserve

the page parameter stays in the signatures because the deployed call sites pass it, but every rule reads only the row's own provenance and text; the page-level containment rule already exists in confidence
the deployed invoice variant calls the date check with a runtime clock; this platform's invoice variant takes the date explicitly, which is the existing rule here
only the comments were rewritten; every judgement and every returned string is the deployed one
not_run: wiring the validators to any caller — the reader layer and the model path do not exist yet, and a shell nobody calls would be worse than none
